risks.title: US dollar illiquidity in certain markets
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the first part of the 10-K with strong language ("impedes our ability", "significant premium costs"). The amount blocked in Trinidad totals 59.7M$, and financial actions were taken in July 2025. Persistence since 2017 and strict central bank controls reinforce severity. Highly critical macroeconomic category.

risks.title: Local currency devaluation risk
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly cites exposure to devaluation against the dollar, particularly in Trinidad where the central bank controls the rate. Impact is amplified by the holding of 59.7M$ in local currency. The risk is recurring and linked to foreign exchange management, with concerned language but mitigated by accompanying measures.

risks.title: Impactful international tax changes
risks.score_rationale: The new OBBBA of July 2025 introduces a 1% tax on transfers from abroad, with substantial effects expected in 2027. The language indicates active monitoring and heightened vigilance. Although current impact is judged limited, the potential for material effect is acknowledged, especially for a low-margin model.

risks.title: Tax litigation on alternative minimum tax
risks.score_rationale: A provision of 7.2M$ was recorded in 2023 for AMT litigation in a foreign country. The low-margin model is cited as a vulnerability factor. The risk is judged persistent, with explicit recognition of limitations in legal remedies.

risks.title: Increased currency conversion costs
risks.score_rationale: Conversion costs contributed to a rise in financial charges (26M$ net loss in 2025 vs 19.5M$ in 2024). The link is direct in the Adjusted EBITDA section. The amount is significant but partially offset by improvements elsewhere.

risks.title: Vulnerability to trade wars and tariffs
risks.score_rationale: The risk is cited at the opening of Item 1A with strong language ("vulnerable to changes"). It concerns systemic factors such as trade wars and fund transfers, critical for an international model dependent on imports. Central position in the document.
